info.title: ShopFlow
info.description:
REST API of the ShopFlow e-commerce platform.

## Authentication
Obtain a token via `POST /v1/auth/register` or `POST /v1/auth/login` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens expire after 24 hours.

## Response format
Successful responses look like `{ "data": ..., "message": "..." }`; paginated lists add a `meta` object. Errors look like `{ "message": "...", "errors": {} }`.

## Idempotency
`POST /v1/checkout` accepts an optional `Idempotency-Key` header (max 100 characters). Replaying the same key with the same payload returns the original order and sets `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; reusing the key with a different payload returns `422`.

## Rate limiting
Limits depend on the endpoint group (for example 5 requests/minute for register and login, 60/minute for public reads). Exceeding a limit returns `429`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional (max 100 characters). Makes the request safe to retry: replaying the same key with the same payload returns the original order with an `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header; a different payload returns 422.

201.description: The created order (or, for a replayed request, the original order).

409.description: The cart is empty or a product is out of stock.

get.description: Newest first, 15 per page. Items and payments are not included; use the single-order endpoint for those.

200.description: A page of the user's orders.

get.description: Owner or admin. Includes items and payments.

200.description: The order with its items and payments.

post.description: Owner or admin. Allowed while the order is pending, confirmed or processing: stock is restored and a paid payment is refunded. Other statuses return 422.

patch.description: Admin only. Allowed path: confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered. Sending `cancelled` behaves like the cancel endpoint. Invalid transitions return 422.

post.description: Owner or admin. Returns 422 if the order has already been processed.

get.description: Public. Results are paginated (15 per page) and cached for 5 minutes per distinct query string.

parameters.description: One of: price_asc, price_desc, newest, oldest.
